description: StepCue turns messy study tasks into short, guided focus sessions. Tell it what you need to work on, and it creates a simple timer plan with one clear step at a time. If you get distracted, StepCue gives you a quick reset so you can return to the session without overthinking what to do next.

defaultPrompt: I want to study for 45 minutes, focused.
